headline: Chest-high SSE and a glassy morning — best window before the sea breeze.
today: Decent size for Matunuck at 2-2.5ft SSE, good angle, and light SSW/SW keeps the morning clean before the afternoon onshore moves in. Dawn through late morning is the play. Fish or shortboard for the peaks, log the softer ones — the drive's a stretch but it's the biggest of the clean options today.

daysToWatch.note: N offshore dawn and morning grooms 2ft-plus SSE clean. Get it before the S onshore takes over by afternoon.
Nearly 4ft on the face but a fair S angle and cross-on all day. Bigger, messier — probably not worth three hours.
